customManagers.description: npm pins documented inside the canonical rule files. These are the repo's real dependency surface — there is no package.json — and a stale pin here reaches every consumer at once.

packageRules.description: Keep rule-file pins in their own PR: merging one triggers the fan-out to every consumer, so it warrants more scrutiny than a workflow bump.

TypeScript is held at 5.9 deliberately. 7.x is the Go rewrite, and the rule text leans on 5.8/5.9 semantics (erasableSyntaxOnly, verbatimModuleSyntax). Bumping it is a migration decision across every consumer, not drift cleanup.
